prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found by title with gh pr list (branch jguer/add-anon-device-limit). Its last commit is the benchmark head bbd8c507; squash-merged as 3647ba73 on 2023-12-12, and database.go, impl.go and client.go at the merge commit are byte-identical to the benchmark head. The benchmark base/head diff also contains unrelated social-login and ssosettings changes that are not part of #79265.

tps.bug: updateDevice prepends the query to the captured args inside the retried DB callback, so a SQLite lock retry runs Exec with the query duplicated in the arguments and the update fails.
tps.evidenciaOpus: In updateDevice the WithDbSession callback reassigns the captured args with args = append([]interface{}{query}, args...) (database.go:84). withDbSession wraps the callback in retryer.Retry(retryOnLocks(...)) (sqlstore/session.go:127, 86-96), which reruns it on SQLite ErrLocked/ErrBusy, so the retry executes Exec(query, query, ip, ...) with mismatched bind parameters.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The new updateDevice callback mutates captured args by prepending query on every invocation at pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go:84. WithDbSession enables callback retries at pkg/services/sqlstore/session.go:127, and retryOnLocks invokes that same callback again after SQLite lock errors at session.go:90–102; when retries are configured, subsequent attempts receive an extra SQL string as a bound argument and fail.
